test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of following is oldest production unit of the Indian Railways?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chittaranjan Locomotive Works.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chittaranjan Locomotive Works** is located in **Chittaranjan, West Bengal **(32 km from Asansol).
 
• Production began** on January 26, 1950, **and the first steam locomotive rolled out of the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) factory on November 1.
 
• Known as Loco Manufacturing Works earlier, it was renamed on November 1 as a tribute to the famous freedom fighter from Bengal,** Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das.**
 
• LW is the first production unit of its kind in the developing world, second in Asia and fifth in the world, to manufacture the three-phase state-of-the-art GTO thyristor-controlled electric loco, and the 6,000 hp freight electric loco WAG-9, called Navyug.
 
• It is to CLW's credit that today, India is among the select** band of five nations with the capability to manufacture the three-phase electric locomotives.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ **

 
• **Rail Wheel Factory** formerly known as Wheel and Axle Plant is situated in Bangalore, Karnataka.
 
• **Integral Coach Factory** is located in **Perambur (Chennai).** India's fastest train, **Train 18** which is also known as the **"Vande Bharat"** express was developed in ICF, Chennai.
 
• **The Diesel Locomotive Works (DLW) in Varanasi, India,** is a production unit owned by Indian Railways, that **manufactures diesel-electric locomotives and their spare parts.**
